title: The Door That Watches
prompt: This is the Warden's own curse, written out. It runs — and never stops. Find the line that traps him.

config.symptom: it prints 3, 4, 5, 6... and never reaches the end.

line_hints.0: Starting at 3 is fine — the count has to begin somewhere.
line_hints.1: The condition itself is right: keep going while steps remain.
line_hints.2: Printing is harmless. It reports the problem; it doesn't cause it.

fixes.why: That is the whole cure. The condition asks 'steps > 0', so something must walk steps DOWN toward 0 or it can never turn false.
It stops — but after a single pass. The countdown never counts. A loop needs to approach its ending, not jump to it.
Now it never starts at all: steps is 3, which is not below 0. Silence is not the same as an ending.

config.success: One line down instead of up, and an age of pacing ends. That is the whole of the Warden's curse.
